messages:
Maria (PM): heads up — LumenDocs (enterprise) sent a high-priority intake. They see ~1.2% 5xx on dedicated endpoints during large batch imports. wanting a fast path: hotfix before next release. cc @Tara (support) for details :eyes:
Devon (Sales): they flagged SLA impact and customer exec is asking for ETA. happy to push for hotfix if eng agrees.
Tara (Support): +1. ticket #LUM-4539 — reproduction steps attached. occurs when they upload >2000 docs in a single session, spike in concurrency. I can share logs.
Sanjay (Eng): saw the logs. looks like KV cache eviction + a timeout in our shard-resize path under burst concurrency. not a model correctness issue. probable fix: increase cache retention on dedicated pools and add a guard for the resize call to be no-op when under heavy load.
Maria (PM): can we scope that as a small patch? is change safe to ship as hotfix vs needs full regression?
Sanjay (Eng): small patch possible. plan: 1) guard to skip shard resize during bursts 2) tweak cache TTL + metrics to avoid aggressive eviction 3) add a unit/integration test for concurrent import path. low risk but needs QA on dedicated.
Connor (SRE): deployment constraints: dedicated pools are isolated per-customer, but we still route worker code to infra across regions. hotfix deploy will touch runtime binary — we need a canary window and immediate rollback hooks. recommend 10% traffic on a single pool, 30m observation.
Maria (PM): tradeoffs: hotfix gets LumenDocs back to SLA quickly but increases risk of regressions across other customers. alternative is next regular release (2 weeks) with full QA. customer wants faster.
Devon (Sales): Exec asked for a clear comms plan if we do hotfix. they prefer a canary first then expand. they'll communicate to LumenDocs that we'll run a controlled canary and share metrics.
Tara (Support): I'll prep the customer comms draft once we confirm schedule. also will create a postmortem template link in the ticket.
Sanjay (Eng): propose hotfix branch: "hotfix/lumen-kv-guard". patch diff small. QA time estimate: 6 dev-hours + 3 QA-hours. code review + staging validation same day if we prioritize.
Maria (PM): decision needed: hotfix + canary (recommended) or schedule for release. vote: please react or reply.
Devon (Sales): +1 for hotfix canary. customer priority + exec pressure.
Connor (SRE): +1 but with explicit rollback thresholds: if 5xx rate > 0.8% OR tail latency p95 increases > 40% in canary pool, rollback immediately. Also require a temporary increased alerting sensitivity for the window.
Sanjay (Eng): agree with rollback thresholds. I'll add feature-flag gating and a per-pool switch so we can flip without code push.
Tara (Support): comms checklist: 1) notify customer of canary start time 2) share monitoring dashboard link 3) provide contact window for immediate escalation 4) follow-up summary. I'll attach template to LUM-4539.
Maria (PM): proposed schedule: hotfix branch cut today EOD, code review + merge tomorrow morning, staging validation 10:00 PT, canary start 12:00 PT on LumenDocs dedicated pool (10% traffic), observe 30m, expand if green. Any objections?
Connor (SRE): operational playbook we will use (short):
```
- Canary config: pool=LumenDocs-dedicated-1, percentage=10, duration=30m
- Rollback: DeployBot rollback command if thresholds breached
- Metrics to watch: 5xx_rate, p50/p95 latency, cpu/gpu steal, kv-cache-hit-rate
- Alerts: create temporary PagerDuty rule for this canary window
```
Sanjay (Eng): deploy steps (short):
```
git checkout -b hotfix/lumen-kv-guard
# apply guard change and TTL tweak
make test-unit && make test-integration --filter=import_path
ci -> merge -> bake image -> DeployBot canary --pool=LumenDocs-dedicated-1 --percent=10 --duration=30m
```
DeployBot: scheduled canary command accepted by CI. use `DeployBot status` to watch progress. :robot_face:
Devon (Sales): I'll tell the customer the tentative window and that we'll share dashboard + rollback criteria. Will set expectation that hotfix may be rolled back if we see regressions.
Maria (PM): risks noted: possible unseen stateful race in dedicated pools; we mitigate with canary, feature-flag, and short window. fallback: if rollback occurs, we will open an escalation call with the customer and propose a manual mitigation (throttle imports) until fixed in next release.
Tara (Support): I'll prepare the mitigation steps doc for the customer: how to chunk uploads and safe retry policy.
Sanjay (Eng): I'll get the PR up in the next 2 hours and tag for expedited review. commit message: "hotfix: guard shard-resize during high-concurrency import; adjust kv cache TTL (LUM-4539)"
Maria (PM): thanks. owners: Sanjay (eng) for code, Connor (SRE) for canary ops, Tara for customer comms, Devon will handle exec updates. I own post-release follow-up and decision to expand to other customers.
Devon (Sales): noted. will update account exec after canary. :thumbsup:
Connor (SRE): I'll create the temporary PagerDuty rule and dashboard link now. putting it in the ticket and will ping here when done.
DeployBot: canary created, run id=cb-205123-01, awaiting manual start.
Tara (Support): LUM-4539 updated with canary plan and customer comms draft. Will post final customer message once Sanjay confirms canary start time.
Maria (PM): OK locking this plan. if anything blocks, call the escalation channel. Thanks all. :rocket:
